title: Conway Grid Evolution
prompt:
Implement `game_of_life(rows, cols, steps, grid) -> list[str]`. `grid` contains `rows` binary strings of length `cols`; `"1"` is alive and `"0"` is dead. Advance the board through exactly `steps` synchronous generations using all eight surrounding cells as neighbors. Out-of-bounds neighbors are dead.

A live cell survives with two or three live neighbors and otherwise dies. A dead cell becomes live with exactly three live neighbors and otherwise remains dead. Each next generation must be computed from the complete previous generation, so a change made during a generation cannot affect another cell until the next generation. Return the resulting binary strings. `steps` may be zero.

example.reasoning: A vertical three-cell oscillator becomes horizontal after one generation.
